abstract: Ten patients with Stage I non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumors underwent orchiectomy and combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, vincristine and methotrexate with CF rescue (BOM) as an induction therapy followed by cyclophosphamide, vincristine and methotrexate as a maintenance therapy (COM). The results were as follows: BOM seemed to be effective as a further treatment for Stage I non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumor patients. All 10 patients are alive and disease-free for a period from 1 year and 6 months to 5 years and 3 months (mean: 3 years and 9 months). The chemotherapy should be continued at least for a year, since relapse occurred in 2 of 4 patients who received only induction therapy. However, they completely responded to other chemotherapy regimens (BVP and BOAM ). BOM and COM therapy were scarcely toxic and no serious side effects were recognized. From the above results, it was considered that combination chemotherapy (BOM and COM) can be an alternative treatment to the conventional retroperitoneal node dissection and radiation therapy for Stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者10例に精巣摘除術を施行し、その後ブレオマイシン、ビンクリスチン、メトトレキサートによる併用療法(ロイコボリンによるレスキューを伴うBOM)を導入療法として、続いてシクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチン、メトトレキサート(COM)を維持療法として行った。10例全例が1年6か月から5年3か月(平均3年9か月)まで無病であった。導入療法のみを受けた4例中2例で再発がみられたが、その後ほかの化学療法レジメン(BVPおよびBOAM)に完全に奏効した。BOMおよびCOM療法の毒性は軽微で、重篤な副作用は認められなかった。以上の結果から、併用化学療法は従来の後腹膜リンパ節郭清および放射線療法に代わる治療法となりうると考えられた。
